sloka: अथ स रणविगतज्वरः प्रभुर्विजयमवाप्य निशाचराधिपः ।स्वभवनमभितो जगाम हृष्टः स्वसुतमवाप्य च वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।। ७.२९.३९ ॥
transliteration: atha sa raṇavigatajvaraḥ prabhurvijayamavāpya niśācarādhipaḥ ।svabhavanamabhito jagāma hṛṣṭaḥ svasutamavāpya ca vākyamabravīt ।। 7.29.39 ॥

translations.english: Then, Ravana, the lord of night-wanderers, having obtained victory and being free from the fever of battle, went joyfully towards his own palace and, having met his son, spoke these words.
